clauses.requirement: For a rear-registration plate illuminating lamp (UN R148 Annex 1 item 9.1.1), the communication/application shall state the geometrical conditions of installation (position(s) and inclination(s) of the device relative to the space to be occupied by the registration plate and/or different inclinations of this space), including the category(ies) of illuminated area: 1a, 1b, 1c, 2a, 2b, 1, 2, striking out what does not apply.
For a direction indicator (UN R148 Annex 1 item 9.1.2), the communication/application shall state whether sequential activation of light sources is used: yes/no, striking out what does not apply.

For a reversing lamp (UN R148 Annex 1 item 9.1.3), the communication/application shall state whether the lamp shall be installed on a vehicle only as part of a pair of lamps: yes/no, striking out what does not apply.
For a manoeuvring lamp (UN R148 Annex 1 item 9.1.4), the communication/application shall state the maximum mounting height.
For a daytime running lamp (UN R148 Annex 1 item 9.1.5), the communication/application shall give the applicable declarations of items 9.1.5.1 and 9.1.5.2, striking out what does not apply.

For a daytime running lamp (UN R148 Annex 1 item 9.1.5.1), the communication/application shall state yes/no whether the lamp is intended exclusively for installation on vehicles of category L3 and its designed maximum luminous intensity does not exceed 7.00∙10^2 cd.

For a daytime running lamp (UN R148 Annex 1 item 9.1.5.2), the communication/application shall state yes/no whether the lamp is intended to be reduced so that the maximum luminous intensity does not exceed 1.4∙10^2 cd, striking out what does not apply.

In case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp (UN R148 Annex 1 item 9.1.6), the communication/application shall state yes/no whether the rear position/stop lamp are provided by multiple light sources, striking out what does not apply.
